headline: Southern New Hampshire outscore every other programme
dek: Nine different players have scored Southern New Hampshire's fourteen goals in four matches, and Inigo Burusco has five of them from sixteen shots. No other programme has more than seven, and Pace, on that seven, are the only other side still unbeaten after Bentley lost at Post.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: The tallest bar is also the widest: nine different players have scored for Southern New Hampshire, while no other programme has used more than five.

wire.line: Eight of the ten programmes have already drawn a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut are the only programme still without a win, with two draws and one defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm have won three of their four matches, all three in succession after an opening defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrea Farinella has made nineteen saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pace have conceded two goals in three matches, none of which they have lost.

last_match.line: Southern New Hampshire are still unbeaten and have scored in every match; Pace's next away trip is to Jefferson.

next_match.line: Saint Michael's have not lost since their opening match and arrive off a win over Roberts Wesleyan.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
